subject: general
question: In 2022, Chief Minister MK Stalin introduced the 'Pudhumai Penn' (Modern Women) program, under which all female students enrolled in government schools from classes 6 through 12 will receive ______ each month to pursue higher education.
solution:
The correct answer is__** ₹1,000.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **'Pudhumai Penn'** programme was introduced by** Chief Minister MK Stalin** in **2022.**
 
• The program is aimed at promoting higher education among female students in government schools from** classes 6 through 12.**
 
• Under the program, all female students will receive** 1,000** each month to pursue higher education.
 
• This initiative is expected to encourage more girls to continue their **education **and reduce the **gender gap** in education in** Tamil Nadu.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **M.K. Stalin,** the chief minister of **Tamil Nadu**, introduced **phase two** of the "Pudumai Penn" program.
 
• Following the second phase of the program's inauguration, the chief minister stated that **1.16 lakh students **had benefited from the scholarship program to date, at an expense of **₹69.44 crore. **
 
• According to Mr. Stalin, the scholarship was awarded in **Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar's **honor since, over a century ago, she and **Thanthai Periyar **started a revolution for the advancement of girl children by providing them with educational opportunities.
 
• In comparison to the previous year, he noted that the introduction of this program has contributed to a more than **27% increase** in the number of **female students** enrolled in higher education. 

17
